nvitk.gui.sge.poll¶

Poll cluster jobs via output/.done marker (SFTP).

Classes¶

SgeJobMonitor

Background timer that polls output/.done for tracked GUI jobs.

_poll() → None¶

Check each tracked job’s remote .done marker; emit job_finished/job_failed and stop tracking any job that has completed, stopping the timer once none remain.
